notes: Added missing stories to meet minimum and cover schema, API, and testing layers.

stories.title: Specialty Identification Input/Output Schema Definition
stories.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for specialty identification inputs (free-text queries, symptoms, provider types) and outputs (NUCC codes, confidence scores, classification groups). Ensure compatibility with tool_router and downstream provider search.

stories.title: Specialty Identification Core Logic Orchestration
stories.description: Implement orchestration logic combining regex matching, vector similarity, and AI query expansion into a unified pipeline. Ensure deduplication, ranking, and aggregation of NUCC codes.

stories.title: Expose Specialty Identification via Facade/API
stories.description: Expose specialty identification functionality through the FindCare facade and tool_router, enabling agent/tool-based invocation during chat interactions.

stories.title: Specialty Identification Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for regex, vector, and aggregation logic, and integration tests validating end-to-end mapping from user query to NUCC codes through the facade and tool router.
